newsitem.title: FINLAND: Helsinki ends up, forestries rally supports.
newsitem.headline: Helsinki ends up, forestries rally supports.

text.p: Shares ended solidly ahead on Friday, spurred in solid volumes by a sharp rally in forestry stocks as end-year nears, but the sector's sudden gains after recent weakness still left many brokers sceptical.
The HEX index put on 0.95 percent to 2,405.96 with volume a sturdy 520 million markka, over one-third of it in forestries.

"I would expect overseas investors to cash in after such a sharp rise," one broker said. The sector was led by a surge in Swedish forestry stocks late on Thursday and news of a turnaround on Finnish paper exports through ports, brokers said.
UPM-Kymmene was the forestry star, attracting over one-fifth of bourse volume with a 3.40 markka closing gain to 92.30.
Finnair was quite volatile in thin volumes after its first-half profit came in just below expectations, and it ended official hours close to home at 31.00 markka, down 0.30.
The stock met some turbulence as some operators welcomed its declared goal of more structural cost-cutting, while others focused on the disappointment in its first-half figures.
Nokia stayed close to home, and ended the week around 256, down one markka.
